thread:
sam-marketing: Quick ask for tomorrow's keynote rehearsal — can runtime run a tiny 'needleprobe' to validate coldstart consistency across payload sizes? Need results by 08:30 PT.

Specs: keep it short (<25m), 36 total requests split across 3 payload templates (tiny/standard/longform), run the production variant (redwood-base-7b fp16) and a quantized fallback (llm-lite-6b-q4). No KV caching for coldstart baseline, plus a single small cached run for comparison. Include per-request latency CSV, p50/p90/p99, coldstart heatmap, and one logits snapshot for a longform request.

carol-runtime: We can do that. Two clarifications: (a) do you want sequence-length buckets reported in the CSV? (b) do you need traces for every request or just sampled traces?

sam-marketing: (a) yes, include sequence-length column. (b) sample traces — grab traces for any requests above p95 and the first cold request per node.

lee-platform: Heads up: shared gpu pool has a maintenance window 04:00-05:00 PT. Recommend scheduling at 06:00 PT to be safe. If you want earlier we can try but risk noisy telemetry.

carol-runtime: Scheduling: 06:00 PT coldstart baseline (run_id=nb-1768008990), 06:35 PT cached comparison (nb-1768009130). Concurrency capped at 3 to mimic presentation load. We'll produce artifacts: latencies.csv, histograms.png, heatmap.png, traces.tar.gz, and logits-snapshots.tar.gz.

zack-ops: Queued both jobs and reserved gpu-dedicated-7 for the baseline. Attaching run IDs here.

bench-bot: Job queued: nb-1768008990 (baseline_fp16) — est 14m.

carol-runtime: Started baseline (nb-1768008990). Running payload sweep.

bench-bot: nb-1768008990 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/nb-1768008990/needleprobe_baseline.tar.gz

sam-marketing: Got artifacts. Quick scan: longform p99 shows one outlier at request id req-219. Can you surface the trace and logits snapshot for req-219 and a note on what happened?

carol-runtime: Included traces/req-219.json and snapshots/logits-req-219.npy.gz. Short note: the outlier was a scheduler preemption on host gpu-dedicated-7 (kernel-level softirq spike) during first-token decode — unrelated to model quantization or batching. We re-ran a quick microprobe on gpu-dedicated-8 and didn't reproduce the spike.

lee-platform: We'll add a short item in infra notes: investigate softirq noise on gpu-dedicated-7 overnight. If reproduces, we'll migrate demo reservations to gpu-dedicated-8.

sam-marketing: Perfect. Can you also paste a 3-bullet summary marketing can copy into the rehearsal doc?

carol-runtime: Summary posted: "Needleprobe warmup (n=36 across tiny/standard/longform) ran on redwood-base-7b (fp16) and llm-lite-6b-q4 (q4). Artifacts: per-request latencies CSV, percentile histograms, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces, and logits snapshot for longform outlier. Observed one p99 spike traced to host scheduler interrupt on gpu-dedicated-7; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-8. Recommendation: use reserved 06:00 PT slot on gpu-dedicated-8 for demo rehearsal if possible."

sam-marketing: Exactly what we need — thanks everyone :rocket: If rehearsal asks for a follow-up rerun we'll open a new thread.

carol-runtime: Also adding the lightweight CLI snippet for reproducibility: ```bash
ri-bench quick-run \
  --model redwood-base-7b \
  --variant fp16 \
  --requests 36 \
  --concurrency 3 \
  --payloads ./needleprobe/{tiny,json,standard.json,longform.json} \
  --sample-traces p95 \
  --out ./out/needleprobe_baseline.tar.gz
```

sam-marketing: Thanks — closing thread.
